MirrorLabyrinth_Text_Npc1.en: LUVDISC means love in the sea!

MirrorLabyrinth_Text_Quest0_Ask.en: A WATER STONE shines like a mirror.\nTrade for a MIRACLE SEED?

MirrorLabyrinth_Text_Quest0_MissT.fr: Une PIERRE EAU, s'il vous plaît.

MirrorLabyrinth_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.en: Your BAG is full. Make room, then\ncome back.
MirrorLabyrinth_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.fr: Ton SAC est plein. Fais de la\nplace, puis reviens.

MirrorLabyrinth_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

MirrorLabyrinth_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
MirrorLabyrinth_Text_Stay.fr: Prends ton temps. La marée peut\nattendre.

MirrorLabyrinth_Text_TopazeFindFull.en: Something shines here, but your BAG\nis full.
MirrorLabyrinth_Text_TopazeFindFull.fr: Quelque chose brille ici, mais ton\nSAC est plein.
